description:
Tattooist Gam Soosung carries a peculiar secret compared to most people. She can make her drawings come alive! Thanks to this strange ability, the dragon tattoo that was engraved on the back of a gangster-looking customer of hers had suddenly run off. Returning with fiery anger and getting tangled up in an incident with the tattooist, Gam Soosung has received an offer that she couldn't refuse...

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=5706874), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/65021445), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/1434019843), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/humanistic), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/humanistic_sensibility), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000070369)
